description: This file defines a report parser class for accounting indicators in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including methods for generating graphs, trees, and data arrays related to account reports.

classes.name: accounting_report_indicator
classes.description: A report parser class for generating accounting indicator reports, including methods for creating graphs, trees, and data arrays.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Generates a list of report lines with hierarchy levels and attributes.

methods.name: getarray_head
methods.description: Prepares header data for array representation of report data.

methods.name: getarray
methods.description: Prepares array data for report display, including headers and object names.

methods.name: gettree
methods.description: Generates a tree diagram image representing report hierarchy.

methods.name: getgraph
methods.description: Creates a graphical representation (bar chart or image) of report data over time or periods.
